name: László Kovács
bio: László's journey in motorsport began in his teens, tinkering with go-karts in his father's garage. He quickly realized his passion lay not in driving, but in the intricate strategy and technical aspects of racing. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, he worked his way up through various racing teams, starting as a data analyst before transitioning into team management. His approach as a sporting director is rooted in data-driven decision-making and a relentless pursuit of incremental improvements. He believes in fostering a culture of continuous learning and adaptation, always seeking innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge. What sets László apart is his ability to stay calm and focused under immense pressure, a trait that has proven invaluable in making critical decisions during high-stakes races.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: László is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations throughout the day.
Insists on having a cup of strong black coffee precisely 30 minutes before each race.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
